questions.question: You are at a restaurant with a friend, and your friend accidentally spills a drink on your tablecloth. What is the most appropriate response?
options: It's fine, don't worry about it.
I don't care, you're not the waiter.
That's okay, but let's ask the waiter to clean it up.
You should have been more careful next time.
questions.answer: That's okay, but let's ask the waiter to clean it up.

questions.question: A colleague asks you to help them move a heavy box to the next room. Which response is the most polite and helpful?
options: I can't do that, I'm too busy.
Sure, I'll give it a try.
No way, it looks too heavy for me.
Only if you do it first.
questions.answer: Sure, I'll give it a try.

questions.question: During a group discussion about a new project, someone says, "I think we should start the meeting tomorrow morning." How would you express a disagreement politely?
options: That's a terrible idea. We should never meet on Mondays.
I disagree; the team has been working hard all week and needs a break.
You are wrong. Tomorrow is too early.
I don't know what you mean.
questions.answer: I disagree; the team has been working hard all week and needs a break.

questions.question: Your friend calls to say they can't make their appointment at the dentist because they have a sudden family emergency. What is the best way to respond?
options: Oh no! That's terrible. Do you need any help?
Well, you should have called earlier.
I'm sorry to hear that. Let's reschedule for next week.
It doesn't matter, just come when you can.
questions.answer: Oh no! That's terrible. Do you need any help?

questions.question: At a formal business meeting, a senior manager asks for your opinion on a proposal. You believe the idea is flawed but want to offer a constructive suggestion. Which response is most appropriate?
options: I think this plan is completely stupid and will fail.
I'm not sure, but I think we might face some challenges with the budget.
Yes, I agree with everything you said.
I don't have an opinion on this matter.
questions.answer: I'm not sure, but I think we might face some challenges with the budget.
